jordan_cust: Hey team — hitting repeated mid-stream disconnects when our mobile users switch between WiFi and cellular. Happens ~10-15s after the network flip, partial output is returned and the client shows EOF. Are we getting billed for those partial responses?
emma_support: sorry you're seeing this Jordan. Can you share a minimal repro (client env + steps)? Also capturing the request id would help. :eyes: 
jordan_cust: Repro steps: open app on Wifi, start streaming generation (~20s), toggle Airplane mode off/on or just switch to cellular. On iOS 16.5.2. Sample client: 
```js
const es = new EventSource('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=vern-1', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer <token>' } });
es.onmessage = (e) => console.log(e.data);
// we don't resend Authorization mid-stream
```
After switch we see partial last chunk then connection close with no retry. Request id: rwd-20240414-9a2c. Billing question: customer noticed charged for full token count though output truncated.
emma_support: thanks — tagging SRE and runtime. @kai_sre can you grab edge logs for rwd-20240414-9a2c and confirm whether upstream closed due to TCP reset / idle timeout?
kai_sre: looking now. Quick summary: edge proxy (nginx-lb) logged a `recv() failed (104: Connection reset by peer)` at ~1718504336. Upstream runtime reported `client aborted, incomplete stream` and we see no explicit auth error. Likely client TCP teardown during NAT rebinding.
sarah_engineer: fwiw, when mobile changes IP, many OSes tear the socket and the SSE stream cannot continue. Two failure modes: 1) abrupt TCP RST from client side, 2) OS pauses app (iOS background) and TCP times out. Both produce partial outputs. For resumption we need application-level chunk ids or persistent resume token — we don't have that for SSE.
emma_support: billing-bot — can you confirm how billing behaves for aborted streams? billing-bot: Charging logic: we bill for tokens emitted to the client. If the runtime emitted N tokens before the disconnect, that's what is charged. However we also bill for request overhead (small fixed amount) in some plans. If the customer sees more than N charged vs returned, please send request id; we'll reconcile. :white_check_mark: 
jordan_cust: Hmm our analytics shows a full-response charge (as if 200 tokens) but client only rendered 45 tokens. We have the request id above. Can finance check?
emma_support: @billing-bot flagged. We'll reconcile. Meanwhile, quick mitigations: 1) add client keepalive ping (send a small event or use a 30s heartbeat) so proxies/NAT stay warm, 2) detect network change events on mobile and restart the stream automatically, 3) consider using the JSON streaming non-SSE endpoint that supports resume tokens (we can enable a resume token flag for your workspace).
sarah_engineer: also note token refresh race: if client rotates Authorization mid-stream some platforms drop the connection. Make sure token refresh happens off-band and you open a new stream with new token.
kai_sre: On infra: I increased the edge proxy idle timeout to 90s for the customer's tenant and added more aggressive keepalive to backend. We'll watch rwd-20240414-9a2c and similar ids. I'll post logs in ~20m.
emma_support: Jordan — can you add this minimal repro for us to run? Steps we used to repro locally: 
1) Start stream on Wifi (iPhone simulator)
2) `sudo ifconfig en0 down` then `sudo ifconfig en0 up` (simulate link loss) 
3) Observe SSE onmessage then abrupt close in ~10-20s
Logs we captured: 
```
[2024-04-14T15:12:16Z] runtime: stream-start id=rwd-20240414-9a2c model=vern-1
[2024-04-14T15:12:36Z] edge: recv() failed (104): connection reset by peer
[2024-04-14T15:12:36Z] runtime: client-abort id=rwd-20240414-9a2c emitted_tokens=48
```
That shows only 48 tokens emitted. If billing shows 200 we need the request id for investigation.
jordan_cust: thanks, reproduces reliably locally. We'll add client-side restart on netchange and heartbeat for now. Please ping when you have billing reconciliation.
billing-bot: Reconciliation started for rwd-20240414-9a2c. If any mismatch found we'll credit the customer and update you here. ETA 24h.
kai_sre: follow-up: I pushed a temporary tweak to keepalive on the gateway; roll out across region tonight. Also filing a small runtime change to expose an explicit `emitted_tokens` header on stream close events to make reconciliation easier.
emma_support: great. Jordan — next steps for you: enable client heartbeat & auto-reconnect on network change, capture request ids for any future incidents, and we'll confirm billing outcome.
jordan_cust: will do. appreciate the quick triage team. :pray:
